## Checklist

- [ ] It fits what Cadence is (see CONTRIBUTING.md, "What belongs in Cadence")
- [ ] `gradle :app:testDebugUnitTest :app:assembleRelease` passes
- [ ] Database change: includes a migration
- [ ] New setting or data field: added to the backup (or noted why not) and covered by a test
- [ ] Parser change: added a test and an example in the About guide
- [ ] Added a line to CHANGELOG.md under "Unreleased"
- [ ] I agree my contribution is licensed under the project's license
